text_block_list.text: One day, after winning countless races together with Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —'O sole mio!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
The moment has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! We made a promise once, didn't we?
A reward for our future selves.
"Come to think of it, I believe we talked about that when I got the hot spring voucher from the raffle."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Now that we've reached a turning point in our races—
I think the time is right. What do you say?"
The two of us have been pushing forward desperately all this time. Just as she said, maybe it's time we took a little break.
And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A comodo and tranquillo atmosphere...
Fufu, it's very calming.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Having a hot spring is also quite 'agiatamente.'
If you'd like, Trainer, go ahead and bathe first.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Yes. I just wanted to do my usual etude. Please don't mind me.

With that in mind,
I decided to head to the hot springs a step ahead of the others.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (—Well now, does this finish our preparations?)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Trainer... Now, I want to convey all the feelings I've built up for you over these three years.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Please, let this reach your heart—)

"Soaking in the open-air bath, I gaze up at the night sky.
The beautiful scenery, the warmth of the hot spring... Just as I was enveloped in a comforting sense of peace—"

Suddenly, the notes of a violin could be heard.
And just as I registered it—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: LaLaLaLaLa～～……♪

At first, I wondered
what on earth was going on, but――
Her singing voice, gentler than ever, made all my doubts fade away. The soft vibrations soaked into my body alongside the scent of the hot springs...

I got out of the hot spring feeling
in a daze, as if in a dream.
And waiting there was Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That look on your face... Looks like
you've gotten into an adagio mood.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it seems my recital for you was a success.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Sì.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...I've wanted to tell you this for so long.
My true, unfiltered gratitude... straight from my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Over all the days we've shared... I've put you through so much trouble, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There were probably times when I made you anxious
or put you under heavy pressure.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yet even in days like those,
being with you let me discover so many sounds.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to convey my gratitude—
I wrote songs for you over these past three years, and today, I was able to perform them.
choice_data_list: Then that song from before was... you?!
Then that song from before was... you?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sure parts of it were a bit clumsy,
but I poured all my feelings for you into it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...What do you think?
Did you like my song?"

I recall how I felt earlier.
The gentle melody, the sweet singing voice.
My answer, of course, is—
choice_data_list: Yeah! That was a wonderful song!
Yeah! It was a wonderful song!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Bene!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...An arpeggio in your heart.
It really was worth playing for you... Truly...

"Going out of her way to compose a song and playing it so casually—
her thoughtfulness came through loud and clear."
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Now then!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I soaked in a delightful hot spring
and finished a wonderful meal!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Then what we need to do next...
There's only one thing, right, Trainer?"

After the meal, I was guided to the grand hall—
but I haven't been told what we'll be doing yet.
choice_data_list: Huh...? I wonder what it is?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: A jam session, of course!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's why I rented the grand hall.
I brought a bunch of instruments, so pick whatever you like!

I reached for the castanets she brought over
and gave them a click.

(Shaka-shaka-shaka-shaka!!)
(Click-clack-click-clack!!)

A crisp, pleasant rhythm echoes all around.
With every click of the castanets,
I feel my spirits soaring higher...!
Before long—

text_block_list.name: Curious Hotel Guest
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's going on?
Is there an event or something? Looks like fun!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—!
An unexpected guest arrives...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It seems our sound has resonated in their hearts.
Let's be sure to play for them, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, come right this way!
Please enjoy our session to your heart's content!

"And then, we continued playing with various instruments.
In addition to the guests, the staff eventually came to listen too,
turning it into a delightful concert."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Eyes brimming with anticipation, racing heartbeats—
Fufu, looks like we've encountered a brand-new sound today.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I want to listen to every kind of sound together with you from now on.
What do you say...
...my direttore?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I want to listen to every kind of sound together with you from now on.
What do you say...
...my direttrice?"
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond between myself and Sounds of Earth...
